detail.title: NC320 RGB Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad
detail.overview: The Ant Esports NC320 centres on a single large 140mm fan with adjustable speed from 300-2200 RPM, delivering strong, focused airflow to combat overheating and throttling on laptops from 14 to 19 inches. Ten RGB lighting modes controlled via an LCD display add a personalized visual touch, while a detachable phone holder can be placed on either side of the stand for flexible positioning. Eight adjustable height levels across 7 viewing angles (20-45 degrees) provide genuine ergonomic comfort, reducing neck strain during long sessions, and quiet operation between 28-52 dBA keeps noise levels distraction-free. Two USB 2.0 ports round out a feature-rich cooling stand for gamers and power users alike.
